Admin routes of the promotions module. Every route needs a staff session and the permission named on it; send `X-Resolve-Locale: false` to receive every locale of a translatable field for editing.

## GET /v1/admin/promotions

List promotions

Parameters:

- `isActive` in query (boolean, optional).
- `page` in query (number, min 1, optional).
- `pageSize` in query (number, min 1, max 100, optional).

Responses:

- `200`: Promotions retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## POST /v1/admin/promotions

Create promotion

Request body: [CreatePromotionAdminDto](#createpromotionadmindto).

Responses:

- `201`: Promotion created.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.

## DELETE /v1/admin/promotions/{id}

Deactivate promotion

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `204`: Promotion deactivated.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Promotion not found.

## GET /v1/admin/promotions/{id}

Get promotion

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Promotion retrieved.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Promotion not found.

## PATCH /v1/admin/promotions/{id}

Update promotion

Parameters:

- `id` in path (string, required).

Request body: [UpdatePromotionAdminDto](#updatepromotionadmindto).

Responses:

- `200`: Promotion updated.
- `400`: Invalid input.
- `401`: Unauthorized.
- `403`: Insufficient permissions.
- `404`: Promotion not found.
